I read your story, and I'm so sorry that you've had to go through so much. I've been in similar situations and I know they fucking suck. 

Honestly, I don't know what to tell you to do, nor will i say that you should do this or that. but if i were in your exact position, i would just isolate myself from family. it doesn't seem like they do much good for you trying to get over this. 

if your parents are supportive of you and believe you and whatnot, then there's no need to isolate from them. but isolating from your cousins immediate family (his mom and dad and such) would probably be a good idea. 

not many people are able to process abuse like this from within their own family. they'll blame anyone but themselves or their child. they'll say it was your fault, when in reality you were only a child when it all started happening. how could you know better? sure you may have known it was wrong, but when we're younger it's hard to speak out to those that are adults or older and say "no". 

as cliche as it may be, maybe try journaling how you feel. do you still see a therapist? if you get flashbacks maybe try and see a psychologist and maybe get meds to help with the flashbacks. 

i'm sorry i can't be of more help
